column1: # assets/str_penetrance_ranges.tsv: the repeat ranges of reduced penetrance that og summary collect names (step 09).
# A count in such a range can cause the disease, but not in everyone who carries it. Stranger grades a count only
# against the catalog's normal maximum and pathogenic minimum, so it reads such a count as plain full_mutation or
# pre_mutation. og-summary embeds this file at build time and marks a sized allele in a range with the keys
# penetrance (min-max), penetrance_label and penetrance_citation of its locus in summary.json.
# The intermediate ranges (between normal and disease-causing) are a separate table, bin/str_intermediate_ranges.tsv.
# locus: the ExpansionHunter locus id (REPID). min, max: the range, in repeat units, both ends included.
# label: what the summary says beside a count in the range. citation: the GeneReviews chapter that defines the range.

column4: reduced penetrance (may or may not cause Huntington disease; full penetrance from 40)
